title: Choose Hi Hat's visual world
question: Keep the assigned acoustic-calibration world, take a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Calibrated Silence
options.lineage: anechoic chambers and acoustic calibration plots
options.thesis: Music enters a room built to reveal exactly what is present, never what is imagined.
options.viewport: A quiet measurement field gives one monumental search line to the listener while verified quality sits on a precise baseline beneath it.
options.risk: Can feel clinical if album art does not become the living signal.
options.case: Best fit: the world makes honest quality and focused listening feel native without copying a streaming service.

options.label: Signal Grid
options.thesis: Every track, state, and quality value snaps into one visible system.
options.viewport: The search field and results assemble from whole grid cells, with artwork breaking one deliberate block.
options.risk: Fuses cleanly, but the visible grid can compete with artwork on compact phones.
options.case: Higher structural clarity than the roll, but lower audience identification than acoustic calibration.

options.label: Listening Dawn
options.thesis: Playback moves the room from blackout through cobalt and rose into full day.
options.viewport: Search rests on a black horizon; the selected album introduces the first light and playback opens the room.
options.risk: Emotionally strong, but color-led state needs careful non-color equivalents.
options.case: Excellent listening atmosphere, but less precise than the roll for quality and download state.

options.label: Night Instruments
options.thesis: Each control owns one truth and the listener reads them in a practiced sweep.
options.viewport: Artwork replaces the outside view while transport, time, source, output, and download each report one trusted state.
options.risk: Strong audiophile recognition, but literal gauges could overcomplicate a deliberately minimal player.
options.case: High audience identification, but lower product clarity than the assigned field.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar dark music player, executed with exceptional restraint.
canonCard.viewport: Large cover art, centered transport controls, search rows, and a compact quality badge.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar but indistinguishable from the category it is meant to simplify.
